name: The Sagehollow
description: A small sunken shrine in the southern heath, where the last sage of the Lightbearer's order keeps his vigil.

s_mouth.name: The Sunken Door
s_mouth.description: A stone stair goes down out of the heath into a low, still chamber that smells of cold wax. Stone figures line the walls, and not all of them are carved.

s_gallery.name: The Gallery of Candles
s_gallery.description: A long gallery where hundreds of tallow candles burn in niches along both walls, though no one has been in to light them for a long time.

s_hall.name: The Sage's Room
s_hall.description: A small, round, warm room with a table, three chairs and a floor swept clean. An ancient man in a plain robe sits waiting, as though he has sat there a long time.
